scenario: [LCON.2.4.1] over String keys: the case its own scenario names, the open-addressing intern table, places strings by insertion sequence, and Int keys never reach it. Four A facts keyed "delta", "alpha", "charlie", "bravo" in three insertion orders; `ordered` joins A to itself on `x.name < y.name` ([LSTR.3.2]), so six firings and six P facts: 10 facts in every order. A comparison or match that read the intern table's slot order instead of the strings would disagree between orders.
rules_ds:
schema A scope logical:
    name: String key

schema P scope logical:
    lo: String key
    hi: String key

rule ordered:
    A x
    A y where x.name < y.name
->
    emit P logical lo: x.name hi: y.name
